description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Availability, price and delivery-time query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteResponse" name="Availability, price and delivery-time information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ContractProject" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quotes" name="Availability, price and delivery-time information" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes" messageRef="Message_QuoteResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrders" name="Initial parts orders" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" name="First parts delivery" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Cheapest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Fastest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FurtherDelivery" name="Further parts delivery batches" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FurtherDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyParts" name="Identify required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveQuotes" name="Receive availability, price and delivery-time information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Allocate parts to the cheapest shop or shops">
      <bpmn:documentation>Use several shops if one shop cannot supply enough parts. Always use the cheapest parts.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialOrders" name="Order parts from the shops"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstDelivery" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock for a single part"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockThresholds" name="Check stock thresholds" default="Flow_NoReorder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the fastest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" name="Join stock actions"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FurtherDelivery" name="Further parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FurtherDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoReorder" name="No reorder needed for this stock check"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_IdentifyParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyParts" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_FirstDelivery" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReorder" name="Stock is at least 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="End_NoReorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorderJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorderJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailJoin" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActionsToDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" targetRef="Event_FurtherDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToStockCheck" sourceRef="Event_FurtherDelivery" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
